PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001126
DOCKET NO. F 012110 25 CTL # 163224
PLAINTIFF – RRA CP OPPORTUNITY TRUST 2

Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 20th DAY OF October 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the City of Clifton, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax Lot 24 Block 27.07
Dimensions (approximately): 63 x 110
Upset Price: Approximately: $128,602.51 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Unknown
Nearest Cross Street: Bender Drive
Beginning at a point on the northwesterly line of Homestead Street (50 Feet Wide), said point being distant 80.00 feet northeasterly from the intersection of said northwesterly line of Homestead Street, if produced southwesterly, and the northeasterly line Bender Drive ( 50 feet wide ) , if produced southeasterly, said point also being the most southerly corner of Lot 23 in Block 361-PP as shown on said map entitled " subdivsion play", Farming Ridge, City of Clifton, Passaic County, New Jersey " Filed in the Passaic County Register's Office on March 20, 1957 as Map No. 1655, and running, thence (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of a full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff)
Pursuant to a tax search of 06/24/2026; 2026 Qtr 3 Due: 08/01/2026 TO BE DETERMINED
Sewer:Clifton City Acct: 95355 0 07/01/2026 - 12/31/2026 $175.09 OPEN AND DUE 09/10/2026 $194.55 OPEN PLUS PENALTY; OWEDIN ARREARS
Sewer: charges are based on prior Water consumption. For settlements, please call to verify total balance and interest due. Water: Passaic Valley Water Comm Acct: 0188921-018158 to: 05/05/2026 $ 128.28 PAID Subject to Final Reading. Subject to senior mortgage in the original amount of $356,000.00 recorded 05/2/25 in Book M6017 at page 24, current holder of record is GMAC Mortgage, LLC
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
10 HOMESTEAD Street Clifton, NJ 07013
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $118,497.16 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF

FRENKEL LAMBERT WEISS WEISMAN & GORDAN LLP
